name: chingu-frontend
description: React / Apollo client for the Chingu Developer Network

paragraphs: Chingu.io is a web app created with React, Apollo Client and GraphQL to interface with the Chingu API (Node/PostgreSQL). Chingu is a global collaboration platform and coding-cohort generator. We connect motivated learners with shared goals to learn, help and build together.
